title: bug: JetBrains judges a daemon reachable by a TCP probe of 127.0.0.1 only and never parses daemon.json bindHost, so a live daemon bound to ::1 or a LAN address (--host / MOE_BIND_HOST) has its daemon.json deleted and a second daemon started on the same .moe/ (JetBrains twin of doctor's task-576e3005)
description:
Filed by defect hunt task-3488566e (11-04 #17, lane 2: the JetBrains plugin's daemon lifecycle). HEAD bb0bc17e.

PROBLEM
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/model/Models.kt:290-295: DaemonInfo has no bindHost field, so the plugin cannot see the bind that the daemon records for any --host / MOE_BIND_HOST other than 127.0.0.1 (docs/CONFIGURATION.md:16, root CLAUDE.md "Run").
- services/MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt:914-919: isReachable = pid alive && isPortOpen. defaultPortProbe (:1043-1047) connects to 127.0.0.1 only.
- When a live same-project daemon is bound off loopback, two paths fire:
  - ensureDaemonRunningImpl skips reuse, deletes its daemon.json (:163-166) and spawns `start --project <base>` (:180-203);
  - MoeProjectService.connect() also deletes it (services/MoeProjectService.kt:175-178).
- The daemon's own guard would have refused the duplicate. existingDaemonBlocksStart (packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts:619-625) probes bindHost and logs "Moe daemon already running". The plugin removes daemon.json before its spawned `start` can run that guard, and the first daemon released its lock long ago (index.ts:859).
- The plugin only ever dials ws://127.0.0.1 (MoeProjectService.kt:331; docs/DEVELOPMENT.md:366), so it cannot use such a daemon anyway. The defect is destroying its discovery file and starting a second writer.

EVIDENCE: architect re-run on the bb0bc17e snapshot (port 19888, isolated HOME). The plugin's decision is mirrored, no Gradle run: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-3488566e/mine/bindhost-rerun.txt (script: A/repro-bindhost.sh).
  daemon.json: "pid": 2056623, "bindHost": "::1"
  pid 2056623 alive=true; 127.0.0.1:19888 open=false; [::1]:19888 open=true; plugin isReachable=false
  (delete + spawn as at :163-166/:180-203) second daemon "pid": 2056776, no bindHost
  first daemon _run pid 2056623 alive: yes; [::1]:19888/health: 200; 127.0.0.1:19888/health: 200
  both /health projectPath: /tmp/hunt-3488-snap/fixtures/bindproj-mine | /tmp/hunt-3488-snap/fixtures/bindproj-mine
The daemon CLI's own guard on the same kind of record: A/repro-bindhost-daemon-guard.out shows "INFO: Moe daemon already running", and daemon.json pid unchanged.

FIX DIRECTION
- Parse bindHost (nullable).
- When the recorded pid is alive and bindHost is set and is not loopback, 0.0.0.0, :: or wsl, never delete daemon.json and never spawn. Publish a status that names the bind host: the plugin connects on 127.0.0.1 only.
- If the plugin probes bindHost at all, do so only when it is an address of a local interface (the daemon's BIND_HOST_NOT_LOCAL rule; the d6ebe4ab boundary: never dial a host that repository content names).
- Out of scope: the daemon, a relative recorded projectPath (sibling row task-78fa7110 fixes it at the daemon), the VS Code client, docs/MCP_SERVER.md.

FILES: moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/model/Models.kt, moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt, moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeProjectService.kt, moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.kt (MoeProjectServiceTest.kt if the connect() path gets its own case). No open row holds any of them (lanes.js 06:50Z). The gate is `./gradlew test` under the jetbrains-gradle lease.
definitionOfDone: A JUnit case in MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.kt: daemon.json with bindHost "::1", processAliveProbe true and portProbe false. ensureDaemonRunning() returns false, processStarter is never called, daemon.json is byte-identical afterwards, and the published status names "::1".

A JUnit case proves MoeProjectService's connect() path also keeps that daemon.json (no deleteDaemonInfoIfUnchanged for a live pid with an off-loopback bindHost). A record with no bindHost, or bindHost "wsl", still behaves exactly as today, so the existing supervisor tests pass unchanged.
`./gradlew test` in moe-jetbrains (under the jetbrains-gradle lease) passes, and `grep -n bindHost moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/model/Models.kt` shows the nullable field.
